_comment: Ground truth for the shelf photo corpus. See README.md. A photo with groundTruth null is a snapshot, not a fixture — it cannot fail a test until someone transcribes what is actually in it.
_known: At least one of IMG_3699..3702 contains a genuinely misfiled book — a real one, on a real shelf, not staged. That makes these the most valuable photos in the corpus and the only end-to-end positives we have, so identifying WHICH photo and WHICH book is the single highest-value transcription here: it is the difference between proving the detector fires and assuming it would.

photos.notes: 4032x3024. Captured before the Shelf Read design existed, so nothing about it was recorded. Usable for measurement (step 1) today; needs transcription before it can back a test.
